# Taverna Travels

> > A solo female travel blog featuring destination guides, hiking trails, and practical travel planning advice for adventurous explorers worldwide.

Taverna Travels is created by Taylor Taverna and focuses on empowering solo female travelers with detailed guides covering destinations from India and Nepal to the Dolomites, Grand Teton National Park, and beyond. The site emphasizes adventure travel, budget-friendly tips, and authentic cultural experiences.

## Key Topics

- Solo female travel
- Adventure travel and hiking
- India (Jaipur, Delhi, Parvati Valley)
- Nepal (Annapurna Base Camp)
- Italy (Dolomites, Venice)
- Japan (Kyoto, Tokyo)
- National parks (Grand Teton, Joshua Tree)
- Budget travel and hostels
- Travel planning and packing guides
- City guides and cultural exploration
- Trail guides and outdoor adventures
- Mexico and Central America
- Albania and Balkans
- Morocco and Africa
- Photography and Instagram travel

## Travel Planning & Practical Guides

- [35+ Things to know before visiting Namibia](https://tavernatravels.com/things-to-know-before-visiting-namibia): Pre-trip planning guide for Namibia covering car rental and camping tips
- [Backpackers Hostel: How to Choose the Best Hostel](https://tavernatravels.com/backpackers-hostel-how-to-choose-the-best-hostel): Hostel selection tips for solo female travelers and budget backpackers
- [What to Pack for Morocco: Ladies Edition](https://tavernatravels.com/what-to-pack-for-morocco): Women's packing guide for Morocco with conservative dress recommendations
- [How to Get From Zagreb to Plitvice Lakes National Park](https://tavernatravels.com/how-to-get-from-zagreb-to-plitvice-lakes-national-park): Transportation guide from Zagreb to Plitvice Lakes by bus in Croatia
- [Hanoi to Ha Giang Vietnam: How to Get There](https://tavernatravels.com/hanoi-to-ha-giang-vietnam): Bus and car transport guide from Hanoi to Ha Giang Loop starting point

## City & Cultural Guides

- [Best things to do in Jaipur, India](https://tavernatravels.com/things-to-do-in-jaipur-india): Comprehensive guide to Jaipur attractions, dining, and accommodations
- [Best Places to Visit in Istanbul, Turkey](https://tavernatravels.com/best-places-to-visit-in-istanbul-turkey): Istanbul travel guide with attractions, transport, and timing advice
- [Guanajuato City: A Travel Guide to Mexico's Colorful City](https://tavernatravels.com/guanajuato-city-a-travel-guide-to-mexicos-colorful-city): Guanajuato City guide featuring dining, lodging, and UNESCO heritage sites
- [Best Things to do in Hudson, NY](https://tavernatravels.com/best-things-to-do-in-hudson-ny-2): Hudson Valley weekend getaway guide from NYC with dining and hotels

## Hiking & Trail Guides

- [The Best Hikes in Joshua Tree](https://tavernatravels.com/hikes-joshua-tree): Complete Joshua Tree National Park guide with trails and camping info
- [Delta Lake Tetons Hike: What you need to know](https://tavernatravels.com/delta-lake-tetons-hike-what-you-need-to-know): Delta Lake trail guide with directions and packing list for Grand Tetons
- [Hiking Rosni Peak (Maja e Rosit)](https://tavernatravels.com/rosni-peak-albania): Rosni Peak day hike guide in Albanian Alps near Valbonë
- [Schwabacher Landing: What You Need to Know](https://tavernatravels.com/schwabacher-landing-3): Schwabacher Landing guide for sunrise photography at Grand Teton NP
- [Dead Horse Point State Park: What You Need to Know](https://tavernatravels.com/dead-horse-point-state-park-what-you-need-to-know): Dead Horse Point hiking and camping guide near Moab, Utah
